concept: Aquatic backstage with statues and smoke
creativeDirection: Use an editorial location shoot in a drained indoor pool hall, staging the sleeve portraits intact within a physically plausible set where the graphic and sculptural motifs become architecture, props, and lighting.
scene: A wide 16:9 view down the deep end of a drained old indoor swimming pool at dusk, shot from pool-floor level looking slightly upward toward the tiled steps and diving end, with the empty basin converted into a temporary backstage-like set. The far wall carries a huge coral-red panel made of thin black horizontal slats warped into a nose-like dip, while a monumental black winged angel statue rises above it. Pool ladders, damp tiles, scattered extension cables, a single wooden stool, and faint haze create depth.

elements.element: the person from reference image 1 appears in extreme close-up at the left foreground edge, face and hand near the mouth exactly as framed on the sleeve, lit in blue-cyan with two small yellow-orange practical bulbs glowing on either side and thin jagged yellow reflections streaking across nearby glossy tile
the shirtless torso from reference image 2 is staged as a tight mid-foreground figure leaning against the pool wall so the crucifix necklace and rose tattoo remain clearly visible
the woman from reference image 3 stands near the center-right on the pool steps, keeping her direct gaze, makeup, slight smile, and flower-decorated white swim cap unchanged
the large black angel statue from reference image 4 becomes the dominant sculpture at the far end of the pool, silhouetted against the coral-red slatted backdrop
the man from reference image 5 appears in close-up on the right foreground, preserving his direct gaze and cigarette held near his face against a pocket of soft pink light
the person from reference image 6 sits hunched on the tiled pool steps with bowed head, folded arms, heavy boots, striped socks, and stark high-contrast lighting intact
the tattooed man from reference image 7 sits alone on a dark wooden stool on the pool floor, keeping the cowboy hat, sunglasses, white T-shirt, white briefs, barefoot stance, and downward head tilt

the horizontal black-line nose motif from reference image 8 is translated into the far-wall installation, with the blue, purple, teal, and yellow geometric shapes appearing as painted lane-marker blocks and floor props near the lower center

coverSummaries.description: A grainy, high-contrast close-up image in neon-like colours shows part of a person’s face and hand near the mouth, as if holding or touching something small. Two bright glowing yellow-orange lights appear at left and right, with jagged yellow streaks running across the image. The composition is cropped tightly and feels abstracted by heavy colour treatment.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: glowing yellow-orange lights beside a blue-tinted face
coverSummaries.people: one person in extreme close-up with a hand near the mouth

coverSummaries.description: A close-up photograph of a bare upper torso fills the frame. A dark metal crucifix necklace hangs over the chest, and a colourful tattoo of a rose with ribbon is visible on the upper arm at right. The background is simply skin, with the composition tightly cropped around the torso and shoulder.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: crucifix necklace over a bare chest
coverSummaries.people: one shirtless person shown from neck to upper torso with an arm tattoo

coverSummaries.description: A close-up portrait of a woman wearing a white swim cap decorated with a ring of pale yellow daisy-like flowers and green leaves. She has dark eyeliner and red lipstick, and looks toward the camera with a slight smile. The background is softly blurred in cool blue and purple tones, suggesting an indoor pool setting.
coverSummaries.people: one woman in close-up wearing a floral swim cap

coverSummaries.description: A dark winged angel statue stands centered against a vivid red sky or backdrop. The figure raises one arm holding a wreath-like object and extends the other arm holding a branch. At the bottom edge, dark silhouettes of horses and chariot elements frame the statue, creating a dramatic symmetrical composition.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: large black angel statue with spread wings

coverSummaries.description: A studio portrait shows a man from the chest up against a soft pink background. He has dark tousled hair and looks directly at the viewer while holding a cigarette between his fingers near the right side of the frame. He wears layered clothing in dark and muted tones, and the composition is tightly cropped around his face and hand.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: man holding a cigarette near his face
coverSummaries.people: one man in close-up holding a cigarette

coverSummaries.description: A stark black-and-white image shows a tattooed person seated on outdoor steps with head bowed and arms folded over the knees. The person has a mohawk hairstyle and wears heavy boots and striped socks. The scene is gritty and high-contrast, with the figure centered and the steps forming the background.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: seated tattooed punk figure with bowed head on steps
coverSummaries.people: one person with a mohawk sitting hunched on steps

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist black-and-white studio photograph shows a tattooed man sitting on a dark wooden stool in a wide white space. He wears a cowboy hat, dark sunglasses, a fitted white T-shirt, and white briefs, and he is barefoot with legs apart and head tilted downward. The composition is sparse, with the solitary figure centered against a plain background.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: tattooed man in cowboy hat seated on a stool
coverSummaries.people: one tattooed man seated barefoot on a stool wearing a cowboy hat and sunglasses

coverSummaries.description: A flat graphic design features many thin horizontal black lines across a coral-red background. In the center, the lines bend downward into a symmetrical nose-like contour. Around the lower middle are simple geometric shapes with dotted fills: a blue quadrilateral, a purple triangle, a teal polygon, and a yellow hexagon.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: horizontal lines forming a stylized nose shape

prompt: Wide 16:9 editorial photograph inside a drained old indoor swimming pool at dusk, camera placed low on the pool floor looking toward the deep end and tiled steps, one physically real location with damp tiles, pool ladders, faint haze, scattered cables, and a temporary set built into the basin. Primary subject: the large black winged angel statue from reference image 4 rising at the far end as the central anchor, silhouetted against a huge coral-red wall installation of thin black horizontal slats bending downward into a symmetrical nose-like contour. The person from reference image 1 appears once at the left foreground edge in extreme close-up exactly as on the sleeve, face and hand near the mouth, blue-cyan lit, with two yellow-orange practical bulbs flaring at either side and thin jagged yellow light streak reflections across glossy tile nearby; the shirtless person from reference image 2 leans against the pool wall in the mid-foreground with the crucifix necklace over the bare chest and the rose tattoo clearly visible; the woman from reference image 3 stands on the center-right pool steps with her direct gaze, slight smile, eyeliner, red lipstick, and white swim cap decorated with pale yellow flowers and green leaves preserved exactly; the man from reference image 5 appears once in the right foreground in close-up with direct gaze and cigarette held near his face, framed by a soft pink-lit zone; the person from reference image 6 sits once on the tiled steps with bowed head, folded arms, mohawk, heavy boots, striped socks, and gritty stark contrast intact; the tattooed man from reference image 7 sits once on a dark wooden stool on the pool floor, barefoot, wearing cowboy hat, sunglasses, fitted white T-shirt, and white briefs, head tilted downward exactly as in the sleeve; the geometric blue, purple, teal, and yellow shapes from reference image 8 appear as real painted blocks and floor props near the lower middle. Photographic realism, editorial location shoot, crisp focus on every identifiable face, environmental haze only in the background, no blur on people. Strong visual hierarchy with the angel statue and coral slatted wall dominant, portraits grouped in depth around the emptied pool. Dramatic mixed lighting from overhead pool fixtures, cyan side light, soft pink fill, and small warm practical bulbs. Palette of coral red, black, cyan blue, tile white, soft pink, and yellow-orange, creating a moody theatrical intimate atmosphere. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one person in extreme close-up with a hand near the mouth; reference image 2 shows one shirtless person shown from neck to upper torso with an arm tattoo; reference image 3 shows one woman in close-up wearing a floral swim cap; reference image 5 shows one man in close-up holding a cigarette; reference image 6 shows one person with a mohawk sitting hunched on steps; reference image 7 shows one tattooed man seated barefoot on a stool wearing a cowboy hat and sunglasses. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
